plan.notes: Source: Texas Woman's University online catalog (2026-2027), Bachelor of Science in Psychology (Graduate School Preparation). Transcribed from the catalog's official 'Recommended Plan of Study' table, term by term. Source URL: https://catalog.twu.edu/undergraduate/arts-sciences/psychology-philosophy/psychology-bs-graduate-school-preparation-track/ (fetched 2026-10-07). Course codes/titles/credits taken verbatim from the catalog; no per-course prereqs are published in the plan, so prereq arrays are empty (not invented). Rows without course codes (core requirements, electives) are choice slots per the catalog wording; 'Select one of the following' groups list the catalog's enumerated options. Credit total verified against the catalog's stated Total SCHs: 120.
